problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.description_short: Practice recursive calls, base cases, and function call stacks.
problems.learning_note: A classic example of recursion where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description_short: Practice key/value lookup using JavaScript Objects or Hash Maps.
problems.learning_note: Use an object/map to store previously seen numbers for O(1) lookup.

problems.title: Reverse String
problems.description_short: Write a function that reverses a string in-place with recursion or two pointers.
problems.learning_note: Great practice for recursion base cases and string array manipulation.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.description_short: Determine if string t is an anagram of s by counting frequency of primitive chars using an object.
problems.learning_note: Demonstrates object hash mapping for character frequency tracking.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.description_short: Check if any value appears at least twice using an object hash map for fast membership check.
problems.learning_note: Shows the power of key lookup in objects versus linear search.

problems.title: Power of Two
problems.description_short: Determine if an integer is a power of two using recursive division.
problems.learning_note: Focus on primitive number properties and base case reduction.

problems.title: Function Composition
problems.description_short: Given an array of functions, return a composition function.
problems.learning_note: Deepens understanding of function calls, parameters, and return values.

problems.title: Filter Elements from Array
problems.description_short: Implement a custom filter function without using Array.prototype.filter.
problems.learning_note: Practice passing functions as arguments and managing return values.

problems.title: Pow(x, n)
problems.description_short: Calculate x raised to the power n using logarithmic recursion.
problems.learning_note: Divide-and-conquer recursion reducing O(n) to O(log n).

problems.title: First Unique Character in a String
problems.description_short: Find the first non-repeating character using object frequency counting.
problems.learning_note: Combines object property accumulation with string iteration.

problems.title: Palindrome Number
problems.description_short: Determine whether an integer is a palindrome without converting to string.
problems.learning_note: Pure primitive number manipulation and digit extraction.

problems.title: Add Two Integers
problems.description_short: Return the sum of two integer variables.
problems.learning_note: Simple variable storage and return value practice.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.description_short: Find the maximum profit by choosing a single buy and sell day in a prices array.
problems.learning_note: Classic array sliding window / greedy single-pass with O(n) time.

problems.title: Missing Number
problems.description_short: Given an array containing n distinct numbers in range [0, n], find the missing number.
problems.learning_note: Use Gauss formula sum or XOR trick to find the gap in O(n) time with O(1) space.

problems.title: Single Number
problems.description_short: Every element appears twice except for one. Find the unique element using XOR.
problems.learning_note: XOR of a number with itself is 0; XOR of a number with 0 is the number. Great bitwise pattern.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.description_short: Use two pointers scanning inward to check if a string is a palindrome (ignoring non-alphanumeric).
problems.learning_note: Classic two-pointer string pattern: left and right pointers moving toward the center.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.description_short: Determine if a string of brackets is valid using a stack to match opening and closing pairs.
problems.learning_note: The stack LIFO property matches exactly the closing bracket to the most recent opening bracket.

problems.title: Longest Common Prefix
problems.description_short: Find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings.
problems.learning_note: Horizontal or vertical scanning: compare character by character across all strings.

problems.title: Middle of the Linked List
problems.description_short: Find the middle node of a singly linked list in one pass using Fast + Slow pointers.
problems.learning_note: Slow pointer moves 1 step; fast moves 2. When fast reaches end, slow is at middle.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.description_short: Reverse a singly linked list in-place using three pointers: prev, curr, next.
problems.learning_note: Classic 3-pointer in-place reversal. Iterative is O(n) time O(1) space.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.description_short: Merge two sorted linked lists and return as one sorted list using a dummy node.
problems.learning_note: Use a dummy sentinel head node to simplify boundary conditions in pointer merging.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.description_short: Detect a cycle in a linked list using Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm.
problems.learning_note: If fast and slow pointers ever meet, a cycle exists. O(n) time, O(1) space.

problems.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
problems.description_short: Remove the nth node from the end in one pass using two pointers with a gap of n.
problems.learning_note: Advance first pointer n steps, then move both until first reaches end. Second is at target.

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.description_short: Design an LRU cache with O(1) get and put using a Doubly Linked List + Hash Map.
problems.learning_note: DLL enables O(1) node re-ordering; HashMap provides O(1) key-to-node lookup.

problems.title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
problems.description_short: Flatten a doubly linked list that may have child nodes into a single-level list.
problems.learning_note: Use DFS or an explicit stack to splice child sublists into the main DLL in-place.

problems.title: Design Linked List
problems.description_short: Implement a linked list from scratch with get, addAtHead, addAtTail, addAtIndex, and deleteAtIndex.
problems.learning_note: Great exercise comparing singly vs doubly linked implementations with dummy sentinel nodes.

problems.title: Min Stack
problems.description_short: Design a stack that retrieves the minimum element in O(1) using a dual tracking stack.
problems.learning_note: Maintain a secondary 'minStack' that tracks the current minimum at each stack state.

problems.title: Implement Stack using Queues
problems.description_short: Simulate a LIFO stack using only FIFO queue operations.
problems.learning_note: Rotate all elements except the last one on each push to maintain LIFO order.

problems.title: Implement Queue using Stacks
problems.description_short: Simulate a FIFO queue using two LIFO stacks for amortized O(1) dequeue.
problems.learning_note: Push to 'inStack'. On dequeue, if 'outStack' is empty, pour all of inStack into outStack.

problems.title: Design Circular Queue
problems.description_short: Implement a circular queue with front/rear modulo pointer wrap-around for O(1) operations.
problems.learning_note: Use a fixed-size array with (rear + 1) % capacity to wrap the rear pointer back to slot 0.
